comments.story: Joscha Bach: Artificial Consciousness and the Nature of Reality [video]
comments.why: Bach on modelling as a skill applied to all experience
comments.text: I really love his emphasis on modelling as a skill. Its obviously great applied to technical skills like computer science, but he seems to apply it to everything else in the human experience so well. "everything that we sense is part of the same object ... we learn it all into one model ... we call this model the universe" [VIDEO]
